summary: Frontend-only re-test of Talbot brand re-skin (React app + standalone.html). Password gate at both URLs works with 'aspen2050', headings are navy, primary button is RAL 5015 #1171B8, and no green exists in the gate/shell. All 5 tabs render on both builds; sliders work (defaults 10/20/40); PDF buttons are present on both; no JS console/page errors on the standalone. HOWEVER three brand-palette regressions were found that violate the review_request color spec and one critical markup bug leaks raw JS into the DOM on the standalone page.

ui_bugs.issue: Bars and trend line are still the OLD GREEN palette instead of the required sky-blue bars + navy line. App.js line 635: <Bar fill="#8dc63f" ... /> (lime green) and line 636: <Area stroke="#006838" .../> (dark green). Requirement: sky-blue bars (#7BB6E0 or var(--brand-sky)) + navy line (#062C60). Chart legend dots visible in screenshot are lime green.

ui_bugs.component: standalone.html · BAU supply/demand stacked bar chart
ui_bugs.issue: Municipal and Groundwater series still use pre-rebrand colors. Line 588: backgroundColor:'#0891b2' (teal-cyan) for Municipal — should be #1171B8 RAL 5015. Line 589: backgroundColor:'#006838' (dark green) for Groundwater — should be #163F56 Deep Teal Blue. Violates spec 'BAU supply/demand (blue stacked bars)'.

ui_bugs.component: standalone.html · trailing DOM / broken script block
ui_bugs.issue: CRITICAL: After the proper closing </html> tag (line 856), the file contains duplicated trailing content including an orphaned fragment 'entListener(\'DOMContentLoaded\', ()=>{ lucide.createIcons(); });' that renders as VISIBLE RAW TEXT at the bottom of every page (seen in the Overview screenshot right under the footer). Caused by an incomplete/truncated edit that left the file with two </body></html> blocks; the second script tag is missing its opening 'document.addEv' so the remainder leaks as body text.

issues: Gate correctly uses navy heading + sky-blue logo chip + RAL 5015 primary button — palette compliant, looks clean. Confidential footer line reads 'Confidential · Prepared by Talbot · DWFM × KfW-IPEX'.

action_items: Fix App.js line 635: change <Bar ... fill="#8dc63f"/> to fill="#7BB6E0" (or var(--brand-sky)) for sky-blue bars.

Fix App.js line 636: change <Area ... stroke="#006838"/> to stroke="#062C60" (Royal Navy Blue) and update the <linearGradient id='cumFill'> already uses #1171B8 which is fine — but stroke must be navy per spec.
Fix standalone.html line 588: change Municipal backgroundColor from '#0891b2' to '#1171B8'.
Fix standalone.html line 589: change Groundwater backgroundColor from '#006838' to '#163F56'.

CRITICAL: Truncate standalone.html at the first </html> (line 856). Remove the orphaned duplicate block on lines 857-861 so the raw 'entListener(...)' fragment stops leaking into the rendered DOM. Validate with `tail /app/frontend/public/standalone.html` — last line must be a single </html>.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js is 916 lines — still over the 700-line guideline from iteration_2. The chart color regression on SavingsTab (line 635-636) likely slipped through because chart hex codes are scattered across 8+ inline usages instead of being driven by the CSS palette variables defined in index.css. Recommend extracting a single CHART_COLORS constant from var(--brand-*) and referencing it everywhere.
standalone.html duplication suggests a hand-edit that appended without truncating. Consider adding a lint step (e.g. `html-validate` or a simple grep for multiple </html> occurrences) to CI.

Recharts theming: inline hex strings inside JSX (#8dc63f, #006838, #0891b2) indicate manual copy-paste color management; any future palette change will repeat this regression. Centralize in one theme module.

success_rate.frontend: 70% (gate+auth+tabs+sliders+PDF button all pass; 3 palette/markup regressions — 2 HIGH + 1 CRITICAL)

test_credentials: Demo password: aspen2050 (works on both React and standalone)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Standalone.html JS-string escape fix at lines 705-707 and 726 is VERIFIED — those spans now omit font-family and no syntax errors appear in console. However the file itself has a trailing duplicated block after the proper </html> that emits visible raw JS text on every page; this is independent of the string-escape fix. React Cumulative Savings tab still uses the old green bar/line colors (App.js:635-636) — requires updating to sky-blue bars + navy line. Standalone BAU chart Municipal/Groundwater colors (lines 588-589) also missed the rebrand. All other tabs, tooltip styling (navy tooltip + sky-blue label), True cost pie (blue/sky/navy/red), Strategic BaU-vs-Strategic (red vs sky-blue), sliders, and password gate are palette-compliant.
rca of the issue: The rebrand updated the majority of chart colors but missed three chart datasets where hex codes were inlined: (1) React SavingsTab bar+area colors were left at the original Aspen green palette because those lines were not in the `files_of_reference` diff; (2) standalone BAU Municipal/Groundwater bars use the pre-existing #0891b2 / #006838 because the rebrand focused on the simulator & savings datasets; (3) standalone.html was edited by appending rather than replacing, leaving a duplicate trailer after the first </html>. Because the duplicate trailer's leading characters were truncated ('document.addEv' lost), the fragment 'entListener(...)' falls OUTSIDE any <script> tag — browsers render it as text node in the body. Fix: truncate file to first </html> and update the three chart hex codes.
